data.hook: The 2023 limited edition Ale Galán used to rule the tour: diamond power, adjustable balance.
why: Limited edition built around world No. 1 Ale Galán
Weight & Balance System to tune the feel from power to control
Aluminized carbon faces for a lively, powerful response
EVA Soft Performance core for comfort and manoeuvrability
Structural reinforcement and Octagonal Structure for a solid, stable frame
data.playStyle: Power-seeking, offensive players who like to finish points at the net.
data.summary: Get a feeling of what it's like to be number one. The Metalbone Master LTD 2023 is the exclusive, limited-edition racket made with the essence of Ale Galán's game: diamond power, adjustable balance and a premium carbon build.
data.description:
A racket made for the best. The diamond shape keeps the weight high for punch on smashes, while the Weight & Balance System lets you move it towards the handle for more control.

Aluminized carbon faces and a soft EVA core give a powerful, comfortable hit. It came in exclusive packaging made for this limited edition, and Ale Galán used it on tour that season.

tech.name: Weight & Balance System
tech.text: Adjustable weights in the heart of the racket to fine-tune balance.

tech.name: Octagonal Structure
tech.text: Octagonal-section frame for rigidity at impact.

tech.name: Structural Reinforcement
tech.text: Reinforced zones that add stability and durability.

tech.name: Aluminized carbon
tech.text: Face material that balances power and control.

tech.name: EVA Soft Performance
tech.text: Soft core for comfort and manoeuvrability.

faq.q: What type of player is it for?
faq.a: Advanced, attacking players who want maximum power with some control.
Independent testers rate it very high for power and rebound, with good control for a diamond.
Yes, with the Weight & Balance System.

data.clubTake: Pre-owned unit in excellent condition. Ale Galán-level spec at a fraction of the new price.
